title: Meta shifts moderation to AI as employees fear widespread errors
teaser: Meta is expanding the use of AI to moderate Facebook and Instagram while cutting its review teams. Employees say the algorithms are worse at picking up nuance, especially in languages other than English, and can remove permitted posts at scale. Against this backdrop, the group Repro Uncensored recorded 210 cases of Meta account blocks in 2025 and 657 in the first six months of 2026. The company says its latest tests found that the new systems made 13% fewer errors on average than people and detected 10% more violations.
